intro: Patience is a task assigned by Executor Zygand in Tirisfal Glades, demanding strict military accountability for the Dark Lady. With routine field reports overdue, Zygand dispatches an adventurer to collect updates from nearby Deathguards and an unusual sentry. The assignment highlights the rigorous, uncompromising discipline enforced across Forsaken holdings.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Make no mistake, adventurer--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.
Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.
You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
